Q3 2026 marks another strong quarter for Meridian Analytics. Across our 15-person team we closed 14 deals out of 22 opportunities, generating **$1,040,000** in new contract value. - **License utilisation:** SKU-001 (Meridian Insights Pro) is at 94% capacity — a procurement review is scheduled for October.

## Next Steps

3. Resolve the open support tickets (TKT-013, TKT-016, TKT-019) ahead of quarterly customer success calls.
